summary: Sony Group Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Consolidated Financial Summary for the second quarter (semi-annual period) ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS. Sales rose 9.4% year-on-year to ¥6,267,217 million, operating income rose 42.9% to ¥1,098,828 million and net income attributable to stockholders rose 38.8% to ¥791,764 million. The excerpt references a prior partial spin-off of Sony Financial Group effective October 1, 2025, now reported as discontinued operations. No transaction terms or advisory mandates are stated; watch segment disclosure detail in the full appendix.
